names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 15 iulie, «Sfântul Vladimir, Luminătorul Rusiei», with the rank word and the epithet left off.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 15 Ιουλίου, «Άγιος Βλαδίμηρος ο Ισαπόστολος βασιλιάς των Ρώσων», with the rank word, the title and the style left off.

Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 15. јул ст. ст., „Св. Владимир велики кнез руски.“ — „Св.“ is not a rank, „велики кнез“ **is** the rank, grand prince, which `types` already carries as `prince`, and „руски“ is the territory that rank governs and comes off with it. „велики“ is not the epithet «the Great»: it stands before кнез and modifies it, not after the forename as in §5’s «Макарије Велики». So the bare forename is the whole form. `foldchk.py` returns **eight** holders, every one of them a twentieth-century Russian new martyr holding the string in `ru`, and `sr-foldpred.mjs` predicts the same eight — so this is the **ninth** folder on the string and the deepest fold of this wave, three deeper than «Кирил» on 9 July. His baptismal name Василије is in the body and is not stored.

Name page 431 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Святой равноапостольный великий князь Владимир»: every word beside the name is a rank, so the form is bare. The same string is already this folder's Serbian form, and «владимир» is a nine-holder fold this corpus already carries with this folder among them, so the form adds no holder. The baptismal name Василий is in the row note.

birth.note: saint.gr: «Γεννήθηκε το έτος 958 μ.Χ.», and its heading «Αγιος Βλαδιμηρος ο Ισαποστολος Βασιλιας Των Ρωσων (958 - 1015)». doxologia.ro, the folder's other source, gave no year of birth.

death.note: doxologia.ro's life: «iar de la întruparea lui Dumnezeu Cuvântul, 1015». The same page reckons thirty-five years of his rule at Kiev, eight before his baptism and twenty-seven and some months after it, his death falling in the twenty-eighth. saint.gr agrees and adds the day: «Απεβίωσε ειρηνικά στις 15 Ιουλίου του έτους 1015 μ.Χ.»

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 15 июля ст. ст. — «Равноап. вел. кн. Владимира , во св. Крещении Василия (1015).»

attestations.note: The day's second entry and the same menologion day as the folder's Romanian, Greek and Serbian rows. THE YEAR AGREES EXACTLY: the line closes «(1015)» and the folder holds 1015, off doxologia.ro and off saint.gr, which gives the day as 15 July — this very day. «Равноап.» is the `equal-to-the-apostles` and «вел. кн.» the `prince` the folder's `types` already carry, and `office` Prince stands. `dates` unchanged. The reading id431 was NOT opened. THE LINE GIVES HIS BAPTISMAL NAME: «во св. Крещении Василия», in holy baptism Basil, and two of the six hymns address him as «Василие» throughout. It is recorded here and NOT made a second name form, a baptismal name in a genitive clause being a reading and not a form the page prints as a name — the reading already made for `olga-of-kyiv` on the Julian 11 July. SIX HYMNS TAKEN, three troparia and three kontakia, where the folder had none of this calendar's. A SEVENTH BLOCK WAS LEFT: the page prints «Величание» under his name, a magnification, and this corpus's `kind` vocabulary holds only troparion and kontakion, so it has nowhere to go and is recorded here instead.

source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 15 iulie — «Sfântul Vladimir, Luminătorul Rusiei»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 15ης Ιουλίου — «Άγιος Βλαδίμηρος ο Ισαπόστολος βασιλιάς των Ρώσων»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 15 Ιουλίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder's Romanian row already carries, and heads him «(958 - 1015)». The man is the folder's own, and the Greek line gives him the same title the Romanian one does, Ἰσαπόστολος, equal to the apostles. The page adds what doxologia did not: the year of his birth, 958; his father Svyatoslav, prince of Kiev; his mother Malousha, who had first been servant to Saint Olga, his grandmother and the first in Russia to become a Christian; the many wives, twelve sons and eleven daughters of his pagan years; the marriage to Anna, sister of the emperor Basil II; the pulling down of all the idols in the land, the baptism of most of the Russians and the two churches he built at Kiev. Its year of death, «Απεβίωσε ειρηνικά στις 15 Ιουλίου του έτους 1015 μ.Χ.», agrees with the folder's own, so the `dates` object is proposed with the existing death interval and note carried over word for word and the birth added from this page. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The page prints no hymn.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 28.07.2026 (15. јул ст. ст.) — „Св. Владимир велики кнез руски.“

attestations.note: The day’s second entry. The heading is quoted as the Prologue prints it, with its closing full stop, which is what §4 asks for and what `srbody.mjs` now hands back. The identification is not in doubt: the grand prince of Rus, son of prince Svyatoslav and grandson of Igor and Olga, the embassy to Constantinople, the idol Perun pulled down and thrown into the Dnieper, and 1015 — and the Romanian and Greek rows stand on this very 15 July. **THE FORM FOLDS NINE FOLDERS DEEP, WHICH IS THE DEEPEST FOLD THIS SERBIAN WAVE HAS WRITTEN**, and the reason is a two-word rank. The heading is „Св. Владимир велики кнез руски.“: „Св.“ is not a rank, „велики кнез“ is the rank — **grand prince**, which §5 reads `prince` and which this folder already carries — and „руски“ is the territory that rank governs and comes off with it, as a see does. **„велики“ is deliberately not read as the epithet «the Great».** §5 warns that Велики in «Макарије Велики» is an epithet and belongs in the display name, and that is a Велики standing **after** a bare forename; here it stands **before кнез** and modifies it, and «Владимир велики кнез руски» is «Vladimir, grand prince of Rus» and not «Vladimir the Great, prince of Rus». Reading it the other way would have given a two-word form, broken a fold of nine, and been a mistranslation — so the bare forename stands and the fold is accepted. **`dates` UNTOUCHED, AND THE BOOK CONFIRMS THE YEAR.** „Упокоји се у Господу 1015. год.“ against the folder’s `death` 1015 to 1015, `attested`; the `birth` of 958 is not touched and this book offers nothing to touch it with — **no age at all**, which breaks a run of three days in which an age was the thing refused. `types` UNTOUCHED at `equal-to-the-apostles` and `prince`, both of which this entry earns — the one by the baptism of himself and his people, the other by the heading’s own „велики кнез“. `office` UNTOUCHED at «Prince»: the heading says grand prince of Rus and the folder says Prince, which is the same rank less the territory, and **a reader does not improve an `office` string**. No `locations`: Kyiv, Constantinople, Hagia Sophia and the Dnieper are a narrative. **HIS BAPTISMAL NAME IS GIVEN AND IS NOT STORED.** „На крштењу назват Василије“, at his baptism named Basil — in the **body**, not the heading, so §4 and §6 keep it out of a stored form, exactly as Golinduhia’s Марија was kept out on 12 July. Had it been taken it would have folded with a great many men. **This is the second time in five days that this book has given a saint two names**, and on the 11 July the baptismal one was in the heading and the other in the body, which is why Olga’s stored form is Јелена and his is not Василије: the rule is the heading and not the font. **ONE MISSING RECIPROCAL IS SUPPLIED SO THAT THE GRANDMOTHER CAN BE NAMED.** The body says „а унук Игора и Олге“, and grandson of Igor and Olga. This folder already related `olga-of-kyiv`; **`olga-of-kyiv` did not relate it back**, so naming her in this life would have failed the two-way floor. The reciprocal is added to her folder in this same batch, with no row and no other change, and the life then links her. `boris-son-of-vladimir`, whom this folder also relates, is not named in this book at all. **Igor and Svyatoslav take no rows** — a grandfather and a father with no folder this book names. **AND THEODORE AND HIS SON JOHN ARE NAMED HERE FOR THE SECOND TIME IN THIS RANGE AND HOLD NO FOLDER EITHER TIME.** „Ова црква беше подигнута на оном истом месту, где раније мученички пострадаше за Христа св. Теодор и син му Јован (в. 12. јули)“ — the church was raised on the very place where Theodore and his son John had earlier suffered for Christ, with the book’s own cross-reference to the Julian 12 July, where they are the day’s fifth entry and where `ls saints | grep -i varangian` returned nobody. Reported on both days, created on neither. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the day carries only the verse.

hymns.text: Asemănatu-te-ai neguțătorului care căuta piatra cea scumpă, slăvite, puternice Vladimire, șezând pe scaun înalt în maica cetăților, de Dumnezeu păzitul Kiev, ispitind și trimițând către Țarigrad, ca să știi pentru drept măritoarea credință. Și ai aflat pe Hristos, piatra cea fără de preț, Care te-a ales ca pe un al doilea Pavel și a scuturat în sfântă scăldătoare orbirea cea sufletească împreună cu cea trupească. Pentru aceea, săvârșind pomenirea împreună cu tot poporul, roagă-te să se mântuiască mulțimea credincioșilor.

source.text: doxologia.ro, «Troparul Sfântului Vladimir, Luminătorul Rusiei», Glasul 4

english.text: You were like the merchant who sought the precious stone, glorious and mighty Vladimir, seated on a high throne in the mother of cities, Kiev which God guards, searching and sending to Constantinople to learn the right-believing faith. And you found Christ, the stone beyond price, who chose you as a second Paul and shook off in the holy font the blindness of your soul together with the blindness of your body. Therefore, as we keep your memory with all the people, pray that the multitude of the faithful may be saved.

hymns.text: Уподобился еси купцу, ищущему добраго бисера,/ славнодержавный Владимире,/ на высоте стола седя матере градов,/ богоспасаемаго Киева:/ испытуя же и посылая к Царскому граду/ уведети православную веру,/ обрел еси безценный бисер - Христа,/ избравшаго тя, яко втораго Павла,/ и оттрясшаго слепоту во святей купели,/ душевную вкупе и телесную./ Темже празднуем твое успение,/ людие твои суще,// моли спастися державы твоея Российския начальником и множеству владомых.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 15 июля ст. ст. — «Тропарь равноапостольного великого князя Владимира», глас 4

english.text: Thou wast like a merchant seeking a goodly pearl, O gloriously reigning Vladimir, sitting on the high throne of the mother of cities, God-saved Kiev; and searching and sending to the imperial city to learn the Orthodox faith, thou didst find the priceless pearl, Christ, who chose thee as a second Paul and shook off thy blindness in the holy font, the blindness of soul together with that of body. Therefore we, thy people, keep the feast of thy falling asleep: pray for the salvation of the rulers of thy Russian realm and of the multitude of the ruled.

hymns.text: Яко начальнику Крещения/ и кореню веры Божественныя,/ идолов разрушителю,/ блаженне княже Василие равноапостольне, вопием ти:/ слава вразумльшему тя Христу Богу,/ слава освятившему тя Крещением Своим,/ слава просветившему тобою всю страну Русскую.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 15 июля ст. ст. — «Тропарь равноапостольного великого князя Владимира», глас 1

english.text: To thee as the author of baptism and the root of the divine faith, the destroyer of idols, O blessed prince Basil, equal to the apostles, we cry: glory to Christ God who brought thee to understanding, glory to Him who sanctified thee by His baptism, glory to Him who through thee enlightened the whole Russian land.

hymns.text: Правоверия наставниче/ и всея Руси просветителю,/ благочестивый великий княже Владимире,/ святым Крещением всех просветил еси/ и церкви многи славны украсил еси,/ о премудре Василие,/ Христа Бога моли спастися душам нашим.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 15 июля ст. ст. — «Ин тропарь равноапостольного великого князя Владимира», глас 8

english.text: O teacher of right belief and enlightener of all Rus, pious great prince Vladimir, thou didst enlighten all by holy baptism and didst adorn many glorious churches, O most wise Basil: pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Подобствовав великому апостолу Павлу, в сединах, всеславне Владимире,/ вся яко младенческая мудрования, яже о идолех тщания, оставль,/ яко муж совершенный, украсился еси Божественнаго Крещения багряницею,/ и ныне, Спасу Христу в веселии предстоя,// моли спастися державы Российския начальником и множеству владомых.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 15 июля ст. ст. — «Кондак равноапостольного великого князя Владимира», глас 8

english.text: Having followed the great apostle Paul in thy grey hairs, O all-glorious Vladimir, thou didst leave behind all the childish reasonings and the zeal for idols, and as a perfect man thou wast adorned with the purple of divine baptism; and now, standing in gladness before Christ the Saviour, pray for the salvation of the rulers of the Russian realm and of the multitude of the ruled.

hymns.text: Изрядному воеводе и правоверному,/ благодарственная восписует ти вся Русь, Василие, имущи тя начальника и заступника,/ яко избавил еси нас от всякия скверны и лести, темже ти вопием:/ радуйся, великий княже Владимире преблаженне.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 15 июля ст. ст. — «Ин кондак равноапостольного великого князя Владимира», глас 8

english.text: To thee, the excellent and right-believing commander, all Rus writes thanksgiving, O Basil, having thee as her chief and her defender, for thou hast delivered us from every defilement and deceit; therefore we cry to thee: rejoice, most blessed great prince Vladimir.

hymns.text: Отеческу прелесть, идолы, яко суетни, отверг,/ Христа, всех истиннаго Бога, Царя и Благодателя, познал еси./ Темже и люди, изрядны Тому, святым Крещением просветил еси,/ преславне Владимире./ Сего ради почитаем тя,/ яко Троице служителя,/ Христа моли даровати нам велию милость.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 15 июля ст. ст. — «Ин кондак равноапостольного великого князя Владимира», глас 4

english.text: Rejecting the error of thy fathers, the idols, as vain things, thou didst come to know Christ, the true God of all, the King and Benefactor; and therefore thou didst enlighten by holy baptism a people made excellent for Him, O most glorious Vladimir. For this we honour thee as a servant of the Trinity: pray to Christ to grant us great mercy.
